newsitem.title: UK: LME copper narrows losses in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper narrows losses in evening session.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper prices trimmed most of their kerb losses during Friday's evening session.
By 1900 GMT, three-month copper was bid up to $2,253 from a kerb close of $2,243 which was $34 down from Thursday.
The metal was earlier weighed down by profit-taking against a background of a slight easing in the spread backwardation.
Traders said a fall in three-month copper to $2,243 could encourage good scale down buying.
"Recently, the funds have remained keen buyers and the U.S. still seems to be very bullish, so we would get too bearish just yet," Rudolf Wolff said in its evening report.
"For the moment we would look to buy dips toward $2,230, with stops below $2,225.
